alex: FYI: demo run of the bulk-embeds sample app during onboarding hit a bunch of 429s when we ramped concurrency. Live audience :(

alex: Quick repro: `node examples/bulk-embeds.js --concurrency 48 --batch 10 --key sandbox` after ~20-40s you see a surge of 429s, retries stretch out the demo.

maria: What SDK and batching mode are you using? sounds like QPS per-key limits + retries = retry amplification.

alex: js-sdk v2.1.3, auto-batching enabled. We gate inflight with a naive semaphore allowing 48 in-flight requests. No client-side smoothing.

sam: Are retries immediate or exponential with jitter? That's important for smoothing retry storms.

alex: Default SDK: exponential backoff + jitter, maxRetries=4. Our config excerpt:
```js
new RedwoodClient({
  maxRetries: 4,
  baseDelayMs: 150,
  maxConcurrency: 48,
  autoBatching: true
})
```
No token-bucket or windowing.

priya: Two failure modes here: (1) bursts of big batched requests blow past key-level QPS, (2) when auth refresh happens mid-burst some requests return 401 and the SDK immediately retries which can duplicate work.

alex: Example logs show the sequence: `200,200,401 (trigger refresh), retry->200, 429` so retries after refresh sometimes land in a congested window.

maria: For the auth case we should pause/queue outbound requests while refresh is in-flight; don't let them retry independently. That avoids duplicate refresh/retry cycles.

sam: Agreed. Also suggest exposing a small rate-limiter primitive in the SDK (token-bucket or leaky-bucket) so sample apps can prefer smoothing over big semaphores. We can give sensible defaults.

priya: The runtime docs mention "adaptive windowing" but we never showed a concrete SDK API. The sample app should include a simple `createRateLimiter({capacity, refillMs})` wrapper and an example that maps to a recommended per-key QPS.

alex: I hacked a wrapper in the sample app using a token-bucket (refill 120 tokens / 1000ms) and it reduced 429s for concurrency=48 from ~35% to <5% in staging. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bulk-embeds-rate-limiter

ci-bot: ci: sampleapps/bulk-embeds tests passed on staging (1791005800)

maria: We should also add `dedupeOnRetry` for embeddings clients so when retries happen we attach idempotency keys and avoid duplicate processing server-side. Not all endpoints support it but embeddings do.

sam: +1 on tests: add a synthetic load test that simulates server SLO (e.g., 120 requests/s per API key) and assert the client-side limiter keeps us under that under bursty concurrency. Include in sampleapp CI.

priya: And a bug ticket for auth refresh behavior — queue during refresh, then resume with the same auth token. File ENG-XXXX and link to unit test that reproduces 401->duplicate retry.

alex: I'll open PRs: devex/sampleapps (rate-limiter example + load harness + updated quickstart guidance) and js-sdk (expose createRateLimiter, add dedupeOnRetry boolean, and change auth refresh to queue requests). I'll include a failing unit test showing the current dup retry behavior and then make the fix.

maria: Quickstart suggestion: default concurrency suggestion of `min(12, cpu * 3)` and include recommended windowing configs for common demo sizes (10qps, 50qps, 200qps). Call out sandbox keys have lower SLOs.

alex: Summary: sample app will be updated to demonstrate client-side smoothing, add load tests, SDK will get a lightweight rate limiter and dedupe-on-retry option, and auth refresh will be fixed to queue. I'll tag reviewers in PRs.

priya: Great — please add a short note in the onboarding checklist so demo runners don't accidentally run the naive script.

alex: Will do. Thanks all :raised_hands:
